fine_lines.title: past simple vs past perfect
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط (arrived) لحدث في الماضي. الماضي التام (had arrived) للحدث الذي وقع أولًا عندما نتكلم عن حدثين في الماضي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Past simple (arrived) is for a finished past action. Past perfect (had arrived) is for the earlier of two past actions.

examples.sentence: When Anna came, Pete had already arrived.

fine_lines.title: dessert vs desert
fine_lines.explanation_ar: dessert (بحرفي s) = الحلوى بعد الطعام، ونبرتها على المقطع الثاني. desert (بحرف s واحد) = الصحراء، ونبرتها على المقطع الأول.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Dessert (double s) is sweet food after a meal; stress the second part. Desert (one s) is a dry sandy place; stress the first part.

examples.sentence: Ice cream is my favorite dessert.

expressions.example: We can't both talk. You go first.

expressions.meaning_en: That is not the reason we are late.
expressions.example: The traffic? No, that's not why we're late.

expressions.meaning_en: Is this something that happens many times?
expressions.example: Your car stopped again. Does this happen often?
We have a plan. Let's get to work!

expressions.phrase: It's good to see things differently.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الجيد أن نرى الأمور بطرق مختلفة.
expressions.example: We don't agree, but it's good to see things differently.

grammar.title: Past perfect tense
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي التام عندما نتكلم عن حدثين في الماضي، للحدث الذي وقع أولًا. التكوين: had + التصريف الثالث للفعل (past participle). مثال: I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived. الانتظار حدث أولًا ثم وصل بيت. كلمة had واحدة مع كل الضمائر.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past perfect for the first of two past events. Form: had + past participle. Example: I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived. The waiting happened first. 'Had' is the same for all subjects.
examples: Pete had promised to meet Anna at 8:00.
I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived.
After Pete had wasted time, we were late.
We were late because she had fed the birds first.

questions.question: How do we make the past perfect?
I ____ waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived.
questions.explanation_ar: الانتظار حدث قبل الوصول، فنستخدم had waited.
questions.explanation_en: The waiting came first, so use had waited.

questions.question: Which action happened FIRST? 'When we got to the station, the train had left.'
questions.explanation_ar: الحدث بصيغة had left وقع أولًا.
questions.explanation_en: The action in the past perfect (had left) happened first.

questions.question: 'Take turns' means:
choices: to do things one after another
to talk at the same time
questions.explanation_ar: take turns أي كل شخص في دوره.
questions.explanation_en: Take turns means one person, then the other.

questions.question: The trip from home to work is your ____.
questions.explanation_ar: commute هي الرحلة اليومية إلى العمل.
questions.explanation_en: Your commute is your trip to and from work.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She has fed the birds yesterday.
questions.explanation_ar: التصريف الثالث لـ feed هو fed.
questions.explanation_en: The past participle of feed is fed.

questions.question: Ice cream after dinner is a ____.
questions.explanation_en: Dessert (double s) is sweet food after a meal.

questions.question: A 'point of view' is:
questions.explanation_en: A point of view is a way of thinking about something.

questions.question: In the U.S., if you are late to a business meeting, you should ____.
questions.explanation_ar: حسب الدرس، تتصل وتشرح سبب التأخر.
questions.explanation_en: The lesson says you should call and explain why.
